description: Implement scenario authoring/compilation using admitted XDL/profile semantics and provider checks for stimuli, observation cost and activation/recovery schedules.

clauses.clause: Scenario authoring using admitted XDL/profile semantics
clauses.verified: Existing transactional typed conditions/steps/faults/observers/metrics preserve exact source, identities, opaque unsupported payloads and profile references; explicit contributor selection uses the public validator/compiler. Actual classic/platform Autoverse API cases cover atomic invalid references, typed time, payload/count/envelope limits, source variants and explicit/ambiguous selection. Static positive inspection is preflight_required only.

Each installed provider maps the complete selected authored source to its closed admitted configuration; unknown action/target/clock/conditions/sampling/unit/payload/sink semantics remain exact drafts and block execution. The actual admitted startup subset and positive browser-input-loss configuration execute in the complete classic demo; no arbitrary action interpreter is introduced.

Strict versioned provider declarations and independent integral count limit; exact matching-unit Decimal totals; missing budgeted costs, unknown versions, duplicates, booleans, fractional bounds, excess counts and exceeded budgets block before provider readiness/dispatch. Invalid source yields unavailable counts/costs rather than zero. Coherent bounded inspection exposes source/sampling/units/declared intrusiveness/retention/cost with unknown undeclared dimensions. Actual classic budget1 and platform count4/no inherited cost declarations verified.

Public experiment-lite timing/source units bind exact whole host-relative microseconds; target/mode/authority, finite horizon,1–8intervals, duration, nonoverlap/gaps and recovery bounds checked before execution. Actual two requested/observed lease-loss/recovery intervals and active-Stop interruption retain original plan/clock/evidence; vehicle effects stay not_attested.
